identity_cost.detail: card required before any trial: 'A payment method must be specified to purchase Huawei Cloud products and services.' The authorisation is USD 1: quoted 'When you add a credit card, Huawei Cloud makes an authorization charge of $1 USD from your card to verify that the card is valid. This amount will be automatically refunded to your card shortly after your account is activated'. Refund timing 'depends on your card issuing bank'. the vendor's own text says 'credit card'.

confidence_note: The payment-method requirement and the USD 1 authorisation are quoted from Huawei Cloud's own free-trials page and billing user guide read today. The machine shape and the trial duration are not stated on the free-packages page, so they are recorded as unpublished rather than guessed.
